apply.error.already_member: You are already in one of these products.
apply.focus.hint: Decides which stage your home page shows first and which notifications reach you. It grants nothing; change it any time.
apply.focus.note: picked for your job, change them as you like
apply.lead: Your account is not open yet. Pick your job and the products to join; their owners review your request.
apply.note.placeholder: Such as: new here, joining the shop back-end team
apply.pending.lead: You can start as soon as one product approves. You will get an e-mail, and signing in again shows the result too.
apply.pending.title: Request sent, waiting for review
apply.products.empty.title: No products yet
apply.products.empty.why: Nobody can join a product before a platform administrator creates one. Ask your platform administrator.
apply.products.hint: What you can see depends on the products you are in. Resources for the whole organisation are visible to everyone.
apply.products.note: pick one or more; each is reviewed on its own
apply.rejected.lead: You can change it following the owner's reason and apply again.
apply.rejected.title: Your request was not approved
apply.reviewers.admins: No owner yet: a platform administrator reviews
apply.submit.why: Pick your job, the stages you care about and at least one product first
apply.title: Apply for access
apply.who.hint: Your name and account come from your sign-in and cannot be changed here.
boot.failed.offline: Check the network, or that the server is running, then try again.
boot.failed.server: The server did not answer as expected. Try again shortly; if it keeps happening, tell your platform administrator.
boot.failed.title: Cannot reach the server
device.approved.title: Confirmed. Back to your terminal.
device.approved.why: The command line goes on by itself within a few seconds. You can close this page.
device.denied.title: Refused
device.denied.why: The terminal stops waiting; nothing can sign in with this code.
device.enter.invalid: A code is eight letters and digits, such as KQ7M-2XHP.
device.enter.label: Code
device.enter.lead: Type the code that {{cmd}} shows in your terminal.
device.enter.title: Confirm a computer
device.expired.title: This code has expired
device.expired.why: Codes work for ten minutes. Run {{cmd}} again for a new one.
device.hint: Check that the code is the one your terminal shows. Once you confirm, this computer can sync resources as you.
device.missing.title: No sign-in is waiting for this code
device.missing.why: Check it against your terminal, or run {{cmd}} again for a new one.
device.title: Confirm sign-in on this computer?
home.lead: The AI resources you can use at each stage of your work.
invite.error.account_exists: There is already an account for this e-mail address. Sign in with it instead.
invite.error.again: The two passwords are not the same.
invite.error.name: Fill in your name.
invite.error.password: The password needs at least {{min}} characters.
invite.error.taken: This account name is taken. Choose another.
invite.error.username: Use 2 to 32 lower-case letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter or a digit.
invite.gone.title: This invitation no longer works
invite.gone.why: It was used already, withdrawn, or is more than seven days old. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
invite.lead: You were invited to {{product}}. Choose your name, an account name and a password; you are signed in right after.
invite.name: Name
invite.password.hint: Only a hash is stored. Nobody, the administrators included, can see it.
invite.products.none: None yet; ask to join products after signing in
invite.title: Set up your account
invite.username.hint: What you sign in with: lower-case letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen, 2 to 32 characters. It cannot be changed later.
login.error.disabled: This account is disabled. Ask your platform administrator.
login.error.empty: Fill in the account and the password.
login.error.invalid: The account or the password is wrong.
login.error.locked: Too many failed attempts. Wait a little before trying again.
login.error.provider: Signing in that way did not work ({{code}}). Try again, or ask your platform administrator.
login.foot.invite: First time with a local account? Open the link in your invitation e-mail to set your password.
login.foot.methods: The platform administrator chooses the ways to sign in.
login.lead: Skills, MCP servers, workflows, agents, knowledge bases and environments, organised by stage of delivery and synced with one command into everyone's Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and other AI coding tools.
login.none: No way to sign in is turned on. A platform administrator can turn one on on the server.
login.point.flow.desc: The team's practice becomes workflows the AI follows
login.point.loop.desc: Which ones help and which hold you back, with data
login.point.repo.desc: One Git repository for the whole organisation's AI resources
login.point.tools.desc: Write once, adapted to every tool
login.stage.architecture.cap: Map the system boundaries and choose the technology
login.stage.design.cap: Write functional and development designs from templates
login.stage.develop.cap: Implement to the design and the standards, check the impact
login.stage.ops.cap: Read logs and alerts, find what is wrong in an environment
login.stage.release.cap: Deploy to the target environment and check its health
login.stage.requirement.cap: Turn a one-line request into user stories and acceptance criteria
login.stage.scm.cap: Branches and versions, merging, builds and packages
login.stage.test.cap: Write and run tests, cover the edge cases
login.title: Sign in to {{product}}
login.trail.label: Stages of delivery
login.username.placeholder: Local account, created by the platform administrator
page.not_built.title: This page is not built yet
page.not_built.why: The console is being built page by page. This one is designed in the prototype and not connected to real data yet.
page.not_found.title: There is no such page
page.not_found.why: The address may be mistyped, or the page has moved.
setup.admin.done: The administrator {{name}} ({{username}}) is created and signed in.
setup.admin.error.password: The password needs at least {{min}} characters.
setup.admin.error.token: This is not the setup token. Copy it again from the server log.
setup.admin.error.token_empty: Enter the setup token from the server log.
setup.admin.error.username: Use 2 to 32 lower-case letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter or a digit.
setup.admin.exists: The administrator was created already. Sign in with that account to finish the setup.
setup.admin.lead: This is the platform's first start. Enter the setup token from the server log, then create a local administrator account: it is the way in when an identity provider has trouble.
setup.admin.password.hint: Only a hash is stored. If it is forgotten, run {{cmd}} on the server.
setup.admin.token.hint: Printed in the server log on first start. It works once and expires when setup is finished. With Docker, run {{cmd}} to see it.
setup.methods.error.last: At least one sign-in method has to stay on.
setup.methods.error.none: Pick at least one way to sign in.
setup.methods.gitlab.desc: Self-hosted or gitlab.com, with an OAuth application
setup.methods.gitlab.name: GitLab
setup.methods.later: You can set the sign-in methods up later in Platform settings.
setup.methods.lead: Choose how people sign in. Pick several if you like; change them later in Users & sign-in.
setup.methods.local.desc: The administrator invites people; they set a password the first time
setup.methods.oidc.desc: Fill in the issuer address, the client ID and the client secret
setup.methods.oidc.name: Company SSO
setup.methods.secret.hint: Encrypted when saved; nobody can read it back.
setup.privacy.empty.title: No optional modules
setup.privacy.empty.why: This server was built without optional modules, so nothing is collected and there is nothing to turn on.
setup.privacy.hint: All off by default. Change them later in Platform settings; every change is audited.
setup.privacy.lead: Usage insights collect metadata only (counts, outcomes, durations, which resource was used), never questions, code, call arguments or results.
setup.privacy.locked: Turned off by the deployment; it cannot be turned on here.
setup.product.code.hint: The first word of its commands; it cannot be changed later
setup.product.error.code: Lower-case letters and digits, words joined by hyphens, at least 2 characters.
setup.product.error.name: Give the product a name.
setup.product.error.reserved: This is a command name or reserved; choose another code.
setup.product.lead: Products decide who can see which resources. Create one now and the rest later.
setup.product.name: Name
setup.product.owner.hint: Owners review requests to join and manage the product's resources.
setup.product.skip: Leave the name and the code empty to finish without a product.
setup.repo.error.url: An https:// or ssh address of a Git repository.
setup.repo.hint: By default the platform pulls every 10 minutes. Changed resources come in as drafts; publishing is still decided by people.
setup.repo.lead: The resource repository is a plain Git repository holding skills, workflows, agents and the rest as files; the platform only reads it. You can skip this and register resources on the web later.
shell.account.label: Account: {{name}}
shell.nav.label: Main navigation
shell.side.label: Sidebar
ui.fail.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this. If you need to, ask a platform administrator.
ui.fail.network: Cannot reach the server. Check the network and try again.
ui.fail.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
ui.fail.server: The server could not do this (HTTP {{status}}). Try again shortly; if it keeps happening, tell your platform administrator.
users.denied.title: For platform administrators
users.denied.why: Accounts, invitations and sign-in methods are managed by platform administrators. Product owners decide on requests to join in Products & members.
users.done.disable: Disabled {{name}}: web, command-line and access tokens stop working now; platform resources leave their computers at the next sync.
users.done.unadmin: {{name}} is no longer a platform administrator (audited).
users.empty.title: No accounts
users.empty.why: Accounts appear here when people sign in or accept an invitation.
users.error.last_admin: The platform needs at least one administrator.
users.foot: At least one platform administrator always remains. The local administrator is the account created at setup, the way in when an identity provider is down. There are no default passwords: local accounts set theirs through the one-time link in their invitation.
users.invite.error.empty: Enter at least one e-mail address.
users.invite.error.exists: One of these addresses already has an account.
users.invite.hint: They get a one-time link valid for seven days. People who sign in with SSO or GitLab need no invitation; they apply the first time they sign in.
users.invite.links.hint: Anyone with a link can create that account, so send it only to the person it is for. Set up mail in Platform settings to send them automatically.
users.invite.links.lead: Mail is not set up on this server, so nothing was sent. Pass each link on yourself; this is the only time they are shown.
users.invite.links.title: Send these links yourself
users.invite.products.none: No products yet. People can ask to join products after signing in.
users.invite.title: Invite colleagues
users.invites.empty.title: No invitations waiting
users.invites.empty.why: Invite colleagues who will use a local account. People who sign in with SSO or GitLab need no invitation.
users.invites.foot: Each link works once and for seven days. Withdrawing one stops it at once.
users.invites.revoked: Withdrawn: the link for {{email}} no longer works.
users.lead: People sign in with company SSO, GitLab or a local account, and the first time they ask for products and pick their job themselves. Here you decide on requests, change who administers the platform and disable accounts.
users.methods.error.changed: Someone changed the sign-in methods meanwhile. Close this and open it again.
users.methods.error.last: At least one sign-in method has to stay on.
users.methods.more: Add a method or change its addresses in
users.methods.secret.hint: Only in the browser; an AI tool cannot fill it in.
users.methods.secret.saved: <saved; enter a new value to replace it>
users.methods.title: Sign-in methods
users.reject.error.empty: Write why, so they know what to change.
users.reject.reason.placeholder: Such as: check with your team lead which product to join first
users.reject.title: Decline the request
users.requests.approved: Approved: {{name}} gets the resources of {{product}} from their next sign-in.
users.requests.empty.title: No requests waiting
users.requests.empty.why: When someone signs in with SSO or GitLab for the first time and asks to join a product, the request shows up here.
users.requests.error.decided: Someone decided on this request already. Reload to see the result.
users.requests.foot: A product's owners can also decide on its requests in Products & members. Declining needs a reason, and the person is told.
